    Reading:
    - No linear climb. J2's card use plateaus at ~6.2 GB from w+3 to w+8, while 900 → 0 pipelines get made.
    - Then it steps to ~6.55–6.59 GB at w+9 (the same level J1 reaches by w+2, 6572 of a ~6930–6960 budget), with a small being-made blip of 32 (new area or streaming).
    - So: compile-cold early, then the same ~94% card fill as a warm J1. J2 died at w+10 with the card at 6556/6963 (94%) and the PC at 6.7 GB free, 19.8 GB commit left. It looks like running at the VRAM budget edge, not a leak; the shared memory rises slowly 5.4 → 6.1 GB.
